DP3-15 held-out re-inference driver: (A) measures the exact re-pullable fraction of the released DESI catalog via SPARCL probe (~1.3% - the rest carry pod-lost/hashed tids); (B) full held-out re-inference on a fresh real DESI-DR1 SPARCL substrate with the committed r42_phase2 5-seed ensemble, reproducing the native-scale MSE axis (median 0.233) + the injection-recovery validation gate. Runs on CPU in seconds; 0 GPU-hours.

DP3-15 held-out re-inference result: recoverable-fraction bound (86.61% synthetic tids; 1.31% of released rows re-pullable), pipeline reproduction (native-scale median MSE 0.233 == reconciled reference), injection-recovery gate (broad 99-100% @5sigma, narrow >=15sigma), cross-seed agreement. Honest scope: establishes method-level reproducibility; exact per-released-row score reproduction is structurally bounded by pod-lost input linkage (NOT fabricated).
637 multi-survey coincidence clusters (canonical, ACT-excluded; ACT contributes zero cross-survey overlaps).

Merged 8-way 5-arcsec deduplicated unique-object table. 378,480 rows total; excise ACT(200) -> 378,280 inclusive; excise ACT+Gaia(500)+eROSITA(298) -> 377,482 HEADLINE set. survey_list column drives all tier derivations.
Planck CMB native retrain (200 patches); ranked by raw per-patch reconstruction MSE (survey-specific axis, NOT canonical-S).
SDSS DR18 native-retrained continuity slice (77,905); per-object canonical-S scores.
